composition_variation: Create a luminous modern anime portrait of adult Satoru Gojo enjoying iced coffee on a quiet rooftop terrace. Preserve his striking white hair, vivid blue eyes, and slim round dark sunglasses lowered slightly on his nose. Dress him in a fully covering black high-collar casual jacket and dark trousers. He leans comfortably against a broad railing with one hand around a clear coffee cup. Use cobalt sky, distant soft glass buildings, clean white clouds, silver reflections, and a confident relaxed smile. Design for native 1024x1536 portrait format: important forms inside x158..866, faces inside x240..784. Leave the upper 28 percent quiet for the lock-screen clock. Use an original composition, no copied frames or promotional layout, text, logos, UI, weapons, fighting, extra characters, or distorted anatomy.
